name: Euphoria | 28g Prepackaged Flower | Bullet Breath
description:
-Top Terpenes – Myrcene, Ocimene, Pinene
-Hybrid strain made from a genetic cross between Blue Powder & Gelatti.
-It is a high testing strain, making it an ideal choice for experienced cannabis consumers.
-Effects include happiness, Euphoria and uplifted.
-Flavors are apple, pear, and tree fruit. 

The cultivars selected for our Euphoria line were chosen for their superior terpene profiles, high testing THC percentages and unique experiences. Euphoria Ultra-Premium Pre-Rolls are made with Full Flower, Never any shake/trim or remediation. Euphoria Brand Pre-Rolls comes in Strain Specific, Unique, Pop Culture packaging designed to appeal to all Cannasseurs.
